chapter: Bix, Trumbauer and the Goldkette sidemen
title: The Chicago Loopers record and guitarist Carl Kress
summary: Kline lists the Chicago Loopers session with Bix; Morehouse and Virginia praise Carl Kress as a guitarist as good as Eddie Lang.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: Yeah.
Do you remember them?
Yeah.
"I'm More Than Satisfied","Three Blind Mice", Corinda and that was with Bix, Don Murray, Trumbauer, Arthur Schutte,Carl Kress on guitar. I think you were a friend of Carl Kress.
Yeah, friend.
Very close friend. Chauncey admired Carl Kress. He felt he was the finest guitarist there was.
Tell me about him. What do you remember about Carl Kress? What kind of a fellow was he?
Well,he was a....let's see.
Carl Kress, do you remember how well he built when he played, how he played his guitar.
Oh yeah.
Would you say he played as good as who was the other big...
Eddie Lang, was he as good as Eddie Lang?
Was he as good as Eddie Lang?
Eddie Lang.
Was he as good as Eddie Lang?
Yes.
He was.
Chauncey felt he even surpassed Eddie Lang.
Really.
At one time Chauncey told me that he felt he was a great guitarist.
Yeah.
And he died too soon.
Carl Kress. Did you play very much with him outside of the Chicago Loopers?
No.
He wasn't in any band you were in, was he?
No. Except for....I don't think he was on this.
